This is a fan animation I made by inputting characters from the Magical Angel Fairy series into Seedance 2.0. It took me three days to complete, the full video is 2 minutes and 17 seconds long, and this is a clip taken from it. (The werewolf design comes from an AI image I generated before, and the sword in Princess’s hand is based on a concept illustration that was never implemented into the game.)
The generation itself was very successful, but I’ll probably never try making AI NSFW videos again. The main reason is that the frightening convenience of new AI made me think for the first time: “If AI lets people satisfy even their smallest desires so quickly, is that really a good thing?”After finishing this round of generation, I didn’t feel a great sense of satisfaction—if anything, I felt somewhat uneasy and lost (which is also partly related to my sense of identity).
